title: bheka.agent.update_ring_advanced.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-updater (NOT bheka-gateway) when an agent_versions row has its minimum_ring advanced one step toward ring_3. bheka-gateway's POST /agent-versions/{id}/advance-ring updates the DB; bheka-updater reacts to that change and emits this event. Stream: AGENT. Consumers: bheka-console (release dashboard). Per-agent_version_id ordering matters (ring only advances forward); guaranteed by bheka-updater being the sole producer (010_EVENT_BUS_AND_TOPICS section 2).

event_id.description: UUIDv7. De-duplicate consumers on this field.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC at which bheka-updater confirmed the ring advancement.

agent_version_id.description: UUIDv7 of the agent_versions row whose minimum_ring was advanced.

version_string.description: Human-readable version string (e.g. '1.2.3') for console display.

platform.description: OS platform of this agent version.

advanced_by_user_id.description: UUIDv7 of the user who triggered the advancement via POST /agent-versions/{id}/advance-ring. For T-SUPPLY-01 supply-chain traceability (003_THREAT_MODEL).
